استعرفا (form X)
# اِسْتَعْرَفَا (istaʕrafā) /is.taʕ.ra.faː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَعْرَفَ (istaʕrafa)
# اُسْتُعْرِفَا (ustuʕrifā) /us.tuʕ.ri.faː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَعْرَفَ (istaʕrafa)
# اِسْتَعْرِفَا (istaʕrifā) /is.taʕ.ri.faː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَعْرَفَ (istaʕrafa)
